package.name: ctrk_ros
package.description: ROS2 Lyrical composable lifecycle nodes wrapping the ROS-free ctrk core (docs/PLAN.md step 4). The core is NOT a rosdep key: it is consumed via find_package(ctrk) from a CMake prefix — scripts/ros_check.sh installs it to ros2/install-ctrk before colcon runs (docs/DECISIONS.md D-0015).
